summary: All 23 genes labeled in the hypothalamus column of Figure 6J agree with the registered dietary-restriction effect direction: 19 increased and four decreased. None of the 13,804 registered genes passed BH FDR < 0.05. The proposal passed validation, and the offline comparison reproduced byte for byte. [Figure 6J](https://huguenardlab.stanford.edu/reprints/200_Hahn.pdf#page=11)
openIssues: Table S1 repeats 566 rows across the dietary-restriction and young-plasma sheets, leaving treatment attribution uncertain for 22 of 27 hypothalamus-specific labels. The figure and workbook also differ on two signature genes. [BioStudies Table S1](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/biostudies/files/S-EPMC10528304/NIHMS1924184-supplement-11.xlsx)

The complete author DESeq2 table with numeric hypothalamus effects, P values and FDR was unavailable in the reviewed sources. The 23 figure directions fall below the 30-pair concordance minimum, so full verification remains open.
